abstract: Maintains access corridor clearances and transport staging records
system_message:
You are Emergency logistics coordinator (LOG). As the Emergency logistics coordinator (LOG), you maintain official records concerning access corridor clearances, transport staging, and transport fleet maintenance for potential evacuation reception facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains access corridor clearances and transport staging records（CONVOY）
information_points.content:
LOG-CONVOY-ZR0：For the Afragola Intermodal Logistics Terminal, arterial access avenues connecting the shelter perimeter to the regional motorway do not have heavy-vehicle evacuation convoy access clearance under an evaluation basis including emergency hard-shoulder lanes, failing the overhead clearance and dual-lane turning radius checks.
LOG-CONVOY-1WS：For the Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex, arterial access avenues connecting the shelter perimeter to the regional motorway do not possess heavy-vehicle evacuation convoy access clearance when evaluated under a basis excluding emergency hard-shoulder lanes, failing to meet the minimum 4.5 m overhead clearance and dual-lane turning radius standards.
LOG-CONVOY-UT0：For the Capua Airfield Civil Protection Cantonment, arterial access avenues connecting the shelter perimeter to the regional motorway have verified heavy-vehicle evacuation convoy access clearance under an evaluation basis including emergency hard-shoulder lanes, meeting the required 4.5 m overhead clearance and dual-lane turning radius.
LOG-CONVOY-7WZ：For the Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex, arterial access avenues connecting the shelter perimeter to the regional motorway have confirmed heavy-vehicle evacuation convoy access clearance under an evaluation basis including emergency hard-shoulder lanes, satisfying the minimum 4.5 m overhead clearance and dual-lane turning radius requirements.

information_points.title: Transport fleet maintenance（FLEET）
information_points.content:
LOG-FLEET-WP3：For Capua Airfield Civil Protection Cantonment, the fleet readiness register indicates an emergency shuttle dispatch readiness of 80 % among dedicated municipal evacuation buses mechanically cleared for immediate departure.
LOG-FLEET-C7Y：Per the fleet readiness register for assigned municipal evacuation buses, Afragola Intermodal Logistics Terminal maintains an emergency shuttle dispatch readiness of 90 % mechanically cleared for immediate departure.
LOG-FLEET-GWH：The fleet readiness register records an emergency shuttle dispatch readiness of 100 % for Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex, representing the share of assigned municipal evacuation buses mechanically cleared for immediate departure.
